title: Transpiration, Stomatal Regulation and Whole-Plant Water Balance
word_count_method: Saved HTML readback, Unicode lexical tokens in p.teaching-prose only, stripped markup; excluded figures, tables, question/answer, headings and navigation. Whitespace cross-check 13,433.

coverage_matrix.concept: Soil–plant–atmosphere continuum, evaporation and bulk uptake distinction
Stomatal, cuticular and lenticular transpiration; epidermal and mesophyll anatomy
Leaf temperature, humidity and VPD with pressure and units
Stomatal and boundary-layer resistance, series and parallel paths
Guard cell K+, counterions, ATPase, ABA and turgor; cross-scope limitations
Light, wind, temperature, humidity, CO2, circadian and longer-term regulation
Whole-plant supply, cooling, energy, mineral delivery, hydraulic failure, guttation
Potometer, gravimetry, porometry, gas exchange, dataset and experimental controls

scientific_review: Internal first pass checked physical flux gradient, resistance algebra, stomatal voltage and osmotic sign, root–leaf storage, latent heat, WUE and CAM limitations against sourced literature. Independently recalculated numerical answers, verified 58 answer explanations and 20 Part B option matches; illustrative data identified as hypothetical.
editorial_review: Separate second pass checked progression, teaching paragraphs, 11 SVGs, accessibility labels, five tables, ten recall prompts, misconception reasoning, source list, heading hierarchy, reader controls and SEO. Strengthened Part B options, added eight multi-step Part C items, repaired graph scale and reran saved HTML audit.
deductions: Scientific: no external peer review, context-dependent approximations. Pedagogy: dense passages. Figures: static checks, not rendered browser visual checks. Assessment: no external calibration and a few similar conceptual checks. Reader: no browser/mobile/screen-reader interaction testing.
